criteria.name: Sentence rules
criteria.fiveMeans: Procedural sentences have at most 20 words and one instruction each, in the imperative; descriptive sentences have at most 25 words.

anchors.excerpt: 'Before you commit the plan, which the factory needs by Friday, check the forecast and then add the safety stock, and send it once the manager agrees.'
anchors.why: One 28-word step with three instructions joined by 'and then'.

anchors.excerpt: '1. Check the forecast. 2. Add the safety stock. 3. Get approval from the manager. 4. Send the plan to the factory.'
anchors.why: Short imperative steps, one instruction each.

criteria.name: One word, one meaning
criteria.fiveMeans: Each concept has one term, used the same way every time; no synonyms, idioms or phrasal verbs.

anchors.excerpt: 'The forecast is high. The estimate assumes growth. If the guess is wrong, ramp up the buffer.'
anchors.why: Three words for one concept, and an idiom.

anchors.excerpt: 'The forecast is high. The forecast assumes growth. If the forecast is wrong, increase the safety stock.'
anchors.why: One term per concept, plain verbs.

criteria.name: Faithful to In depth
criteria.fiveMeans: Every fact, number and caveat of the In depth view is kept, and nothing is added; the visuals are the same.

anchors.excerpt: In depth: 'Online orders doubled, from 20,000 to 40,000.' STE: 'Online orders increased by a large quantity. The company will open new stores.'
anchors.why: Drops the numbers and adds a claim that is not in the source.

anchors.excerpt: STE: 'Online orders increased from 20,000 to 40,000 in one year. This is an increase of 100 percent.'

criteria.name: Clear active text
criteria.fiveMeans: Active voice, simple common words, articles kept, warnings before the text they apply to; a newcomer understands it on the first read.

anchors.excerpt: 'Stock levels are reviewed weekly and adjustments are made as deemed necessary by planning.'
anchors.why: Passive voice hides who does the action; vague words.

anchors.excerpt: 'The planning team examines the stock levels every week. The team changes the build plan when the stock is too low.'
anchors.why: Active voice, plain words, clear actors.
